svg.text: When a threat is credible: the belief must put rejection at the optimum

svg.text: Whenever p ≤ 2/5, rejecting is sequentially rational and the threat holds; once p exceeds 2/5 the school would rather admit, and the threat collapses.

svg.text: The pooling belief is 1/2, inside the acceptance region — it survives only because that information set is never reached.
